EVERY NUMBER · ITS BASIS · CAN YOU CHECK IT

Check my numbers

Every number on this site, with what it rests on, where it appears and whether you can check it without taking my word for it.

About my work or about the site itself, each number is here once, with every page it appears on. The pages mark each one with its entry, and a test fails the build if a page prints a number that is not here, or one that disagrees with its entry. What the narration says aloud is held to the same list.

Checkable from outside

You can check these yourself. Each says where: a source, a public file, or the case study that says how.

  • 10,226 river sub-basins modelled with the MARINA-Multi model

    Basis Coastal Water Pollution Dynamics, “10,226 sub-basins modelled”: The sub-basin count of the MARINA-Multi model configuration used — a property of the model domain, not an estimate.

    Checkable from outside: Case studies Where Home · Case studies · Research · Field report · the narration

  • 3,984 cross-engine checks passing in GAIA: its workbook, web estimator and reference code giving the same answers

    Basis GAIA — Green AI Assessment, “The workbook, the web estimator and the reference code give the same answers: 3,984 cross-engine checks pass”: tests/test_engine.py, in the repository, runs the three on the same cases and fails if any disagrees; its roadmap records 3,984 passing at version 2.2.0. An engineering fact, not a result for any organisation.

    Checkable from outside: Case studies Where Case studies

  • 276 KB over the wire: the homepage's first view, fonts included

    Basis The budget “First view of the homepage, over the wire (fonts included)”, measured by npm run budget on every build. The build fails if the homepage outgrows its ceiling or a page quotes another figure, and a real browser checks the estimate in CI.

    Checkable from outside: github.com Where Home · Case studies

    Basis The budget “Text-only field report, the HTML file (the size the footer quotes)”, measured by npm run budget on every build. The file as saved, uncompressed: the size a reader can check by saving the page.

Not checkable from outside

These rest on records someone else holds, a client, an employer or the UN, or on no source at all. Each says which, and none is dressed up as more.

  • 164 water points delivered across Sierra Leone

    Basis Groundwater Potential Mapping, “Method carried into the borehole siting that followed, part of 164 water points delivered across Sierra Leone”: The boreholes behind the strike rate above were sited with the survey method in the Team & Team International fieldwork. They are part of the 164 water points — 100 hand-dug wells rehabilitated, 50 boreholes constructed, 14 solar-powered boreholes, itemised and summing to 164 — but not all of them: a rehabilitated well needs no siting, and no survey siting is recorded for the other boreholes. The mapping informed siting; it is not the sole cause of the outcome.

    Not checkable from outside Where Home · Case studies · Research · Field report · the narration

  • 100 hand-dug wells rehabilitated: part of those water points

    Basis The same result as water points delivered across Sierra Leone, in Groundwater Potential Mapping.

    Not checkable from outside Where Home · Case studies · Field report

  • 50 boreholes constructed: part of those water points

    Basis The same result as water points delivered across Sierra Leone, in Groundwater Potential Mapping.

    Not checkable from outside Where Home · Case studies · Field report

  • 14 solar-powered boreholes with storage tanks: the rest of them

    Basis The same result as water points delivered across Sierra Leone, in Groundwater Potential Mapping.

    Not checkable from outside Where Home · Case studies · Field report

  • 70% aquifer strike rate on the boreholes sited with the resistivity survey

    Basis Groundwater Potential Mapping, “70% aquifer strike rate in subsequent drilling”: Successful strikes as a share of boreholes drilled on sites selected with the survey method, during the Team & Team International fieldwork. The site sets it beside roughly 30% for blind siting in the same geology, but no source for that baseline is recorded — so wherever the 30% appears it is labelled illustrative, not measured.

    Not checkable from outside Where Home · Case studies · Field report · the narration

  • 30% strike rate for blind siting in the same geology: the comparison the borehole game draws

    Basis Illustrative. No source for this baseline is recorded. It stays because the comparison is the point of the game, and wherever it is shown it is labelled illustrative.

    Not checkable from outside Where Case studies

Not on this list

Years and dates, section numbers, the names of standards such as Scope 2 or SDG 13, places’ coordinates and my phone number are numerals, not claims. The figures the calculators work out in your browser, in the EcoPrompt Coach, in the chart on the homepage and on the footer’s receipt, are model outputs: their inputs are above, and every factor behind them is in the calculator’s evidence ledger. The open counts are the visit counter’s own, rewritten each week.
